supersedingDecision.decision: Cratis/AI is installed directly from its default branch through four committed marketplace manifests that resolve its real skills/ and engineering/ directories. Generated distribution is retired in full: there is no second write target, no release branch, no dist/vX.Y.Z tag namespace, and no generated tree. Cratis/AI.Distribution's published v0.1.0 to v0.3.0 tags keep resolving and are never deleted; the repository is archived rather than mirrored.
supersedingDecision.note: The repository block below still reports the observed live state of Cratis/AI.Distribution. No workflow in Cratis/AI writes to it any more.

retirementApplied.note: The distribution branch and the dist/* tag ruleset that had been created on 2026-09-06 were deleted the same day by the repository admin through the GitHub API, before any release ran against them. Neither exists now: GET /repos/Cratis/AI/branches lists no distribution branch and GET /repos/Cratis/AI/rulesets is empty.

protectedEnvironmentsStillLive.npm-stage: Used by release-passive-previews.yml, the real npm trusted publish for @cratis/ai-fundamentals. Branch policy only; no required reviewer, matching npm-stage-contract.json's environmentApprovalRequired: false.
protectedEnvironmentsStillLive.distribution-canary: Still configured with woksin as required reviewer, but no remaining workflow declares it. Whether to delete it is a separate decision.

findings: The contract in distribution/generated-repository-authority-request.md states that human or deploy-key direct pushes are not an accepted update path, yet commits 5d5c366, 53c607f, and 8f31eb0 in Cratis/AI.Distribution were authored directly by a maintainer rather than by the release bot, because the Cratis/Workflows#72 App is still not installed.
credential.state is REMOVED_AFTER_ONE_TIME_INITIALIZATION and repository.writeCredentialState is ABSENT_PENDING_PR_RELEASE_BOT, so the second repository never had a compliant automated write path.
Retirement removes the cross-repository App, the AI_DISTRIBUTION_APP_ID and AI_DISTRIBUTION_APP_PRIVATE_KEY secrets, the duplicated control plane, and both extra branch-protection surfaces.
